children.text: Runs over traditional copper phone lines, speed dependent technology and distance

Different DOCSIS version and companies allow for different speed options

Phone and cable companies are building FTTH and business solutions allowing speeds up to 10 Gig, with typical speed threshold of 1 Gbps
4G allows downloads of 5-12 Mbps, but may peak upwards of 50 Mbps
5G – standards being developed but speeds will be comparable to “Fiber”
Offering speeds of 10-50 Mbps depending on application, terrain, etc.
Speeds up to 25 Mbps, but is typically more expensive, may have data caps, or latency issues
